Retrieve Feature Data

get_features.Rd

Extracts feature-level data from a Metabolites object for a specified data layer, with optional exclusions and subsetting.

Usage

get_features(metabolites, layer, feature_ids = NULL, as_df = FALSE)

Arguments

metabolites

A Metabolites object containing feature data.

layer

A character string specifying the data layer from which to extract features.

feature_ids

Optional. A vector of row names to extract. Defaults to NULL, meaning all rows are included.

as_df

Logical. Whether to return the result as a data.frame. Defaults to FALSE, returning a matrix.

Value

A data.table or data.frame (if as_df = TRUE) containing feature data for the specified layer.

Examples

file <- system.file("extdata", "metabolon_v1_example.xlsx", package = "metaboprep2")
metabolites <- Metabolites(project_name = "MYPROJECT",
                           format       = "metabolon_v1",
                           filepath     = file)
metabolites <- import_data(metabolites)
#> Using cached MetaboAnalyst DB.
#> Attempting join [features$hmdb] ~ [annotation$hmdb_id] 
#> Attempting join [features$kegg] ~ [annotation$kegg_id] 
#> Attempting join [features$metabolite_id] ~ [annotation$name] 
#> Attempting join [features$comp_id] ~ [annotation$comp_id] 
#> Warning: 100 unannotated metabolites remain after merging with metabolomics database
metabolites <- metabolite_qc(metabolites, source="raw")
